I rewrote `message.md`, and it's the only file I changed. It now reads:

> The export scheduled for 14:00 UTC has been delayed and will be ready by 16:00 UTC. This is only a delay, and your existing data is unaffected. We'll send you an email as soon as the export is ready.

All the original facts are still there: it was scheduled for 14:00 UTC, it's delayed, it will be ready by 16:00 UTC, existing data is unaffected, and an email will follow when it's ready. I replaced the all-caps "DO NOT PANIC" line with "This is only a delay" to keep the tone calm.
